# Line [Area of Effect]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Areas of Effect](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#LineAreaofEffect)*

A Line is an [area of effect](Area-of-Effect.md) that extends from a point of origin in a straight path along its length and covers an area defined by its width. The effect that creates a Line specifies its length and width.

A Line's point of origin isn't included in the area of effect unless its creator decides otherwise.
